entityDescription: Eurospace - a non-profit organisation founded in 1961 - fosters the development of space activities in Europe and promotes a better understanding of space industry related issues and problems. Its members are the main space industry manufacturers and launcher service providers. Eurospace members cover the whole span of the space industrial chain, are present in 13 European countries and represent more than 90% of the European space industry activity from both a turnover and employment point of view. Eurospace plays a key role in the European Space Technology Strategy process, officially presenting the whole European space manufacturing industry views on technology evolution and harmonisation. With 50 years of presence in the space policy arena, Eurospace has established and maintains a comprehensive network of contacts with the main national space agencies in Europe (ASI, UKSA, CNES, DLR,...) and with the relevant national ministries. As policy evolution required, Eurospace extended its reach to new institutions, such as the WEU, EDA or the French DGA for defence matters. Eurospace mandate covers the relevant EU bodies, including Commission Directorate Generals, the Council, the Parliament etc. and eventually Eurospace established a dedicated office in Brussels in 2001. Eurospace is a recognised interlocutor to the European Union, and an active participant to EU led industry consultations on space, providing data, analysis and assessments on space industry related issues to relevant DGs as required.

Short Description:

Salutes Space offers Space Infrastructure Services to promote Life 3.0, Web 3.0 and Decentralization in the form of A.I./IoSTs/Drones, 6G/SBSP/Satellites and EdTech services.
Slogan:
Your company needs a space strategy, your company needs salutes.
Mission Statement:
Salutes Space aims to revolutionize the Space Industry by promoting Life 3.0 through the provision of decentralized, blockchain-based advanced Space Infrastructure as a Service, utilizing cutting-edge technology in Satellites, Artificial Intelligence, IT, Cloud services, Drones, and EdTech for research, development, and services such as earth observation, telecommunications, and remote sensing
Business objectives:
The planning and execution of space missions using artificial intelligence, IT and EdTech, the development and production of space-related technologies and systems, the provision of satellite operations services, space technology consulting, and the provision of space infrastructure services (SIS) with a focus on the use of neuromorphic and quantum computing and space-based solar power, IoT, drones, and, as well as the use of space-based technologies and distributed systems to provide valuable data and infrastructure to support the development of smart cities through the deployment of next-generation satellite communications technologies to ensure quality of service distribution and cybersecurity. The company may enter into any transaction that serves the aforementioned object. The company is, furthermore, entitled to establish branches and/or subsidiaries in Germany and abroad.

Vision:
Decentralization in space technology means distributing decision-making power and resources away from a centralized authority. This is achieved through the use of autonomous and semi-autonomous systems, such as swarm robotics and blockchain technology, to reduce reliance on centralized control and increase distributed coordination and collaboration. The overall goal of decentralization in space technology is to create more resilient and efficient systems that can adapt to changing circumstances and operate independently, increasing the sustainability of space technology. The concept of decentralization in space technology provides high value to smart cities, which rely on technology to create efficient and sustainable urban systems.

CShark was founded in 2018 as an innovation-oriented startup.
Since then we have specialized in the design of integrated IoT and satellite communication systems.
We develop customized software and hardware solutions for both medium and large-sized companies, as well as small businesses and commercial enterprises.
We believe that technology can improve people's lives and business operations.
We help our clients make the technological leap needed to enter the future with smart solutions that simplify processes, increase efficiency, and make them stronger and more competitive.
Thanks to constant research activities, in-house transversal skills, and important collaborations with national and international partners, we can support our clients with qualified service in different areas, from high-level software programming to IT consulting and training on Web 4.0, from the design and implementation of data-center architectures to the creation of IoT and HPC equipment with innovative hardware.
OUR METHOD
Expertise, experience and flexibility for global service
CShark's team consists of a group of professionals with complementary skills and solid experience in various areas of ICT.
Thus we can help our clients find the most advanced solutions to various problems in technology with a comprehensive service managed in-house and developed around their needs.
Innovation and support for business growth
We have a flexible structure that allows us to adapt to changes in the market and follow each project with care, accompanying the client on its digitalization journey.
Innovation is in our DNA, we like to measure ourselves with new challenges and seek novel answers that put technology at the service of people.

entityDescription:
Crowdpolicy is an SME founded in 2012, active in the field of IT and specialized in crowdsourcing methods and techniques within the fields of fintech, civictech and open innovation. Our company’s aim is to develop methodologies and technologies for crowd participation in organisations, a mentality that is reflected in the company's mission statement: Bridge the gap between organisations and the crowd.
During its 10 years of operation, Crowdpolicy has implemented numerous projects developing complex information systems for the private and public sector, companies, financial institutions and local governments such as municipalities, regions and ministries. It has also implemented numerous events, workshops and competitions related to the promotion of innovation in various thematic areas.
Crowdpolicy has built on open technologies and data, as well as open innovation processes, developing applications and platforms in the fintech, govtech and open innovation sectors (hackathons, accelerators, etc.). This mentality still permeates the operation of the business, with the result that many parts of the technology produced are openly disseminated in order to generate wider added value.
Today Crowdpolicy is active in developing applications and platforms in the key areas of Fintech, Govtech/Civictech, Open Innovation and AI Chatbot development building on open technologies and data, as well as open innovation processes.
The founders of the company have actively participated on c-level positions in more than 30 flagship digital transformation projects in Greece, such as Opengov (consultations, recruitment), Clarity - diavgeia (post decisions of public sector), Open Innovation for Public Administration, Open Data – Geodata and more. Building on that background, the company has worked on open data and collaborative principles, turning them into applications and platforms within the fields of govtech/civictech, fintech and open innovation (hackathons and accelerators for the later). CrowdPolicy is also a member of the Eurocrowd- European Crowdfunding Network. On most of these project the main role of Crowdpolicy is the development of digital tools and existing know-how for their implementation as well as the dissemination of innovative productive and pilot applications through numerous channels, being in a privileged position to upgrade the know-how acquired by the execution of this project.

entityDescription:
CNIM Systèmes Industriels (CSI) has an expertise in the engineering and manufacturing of high added-value and large components for space applications. Its expertise and competencies lies in large dimensions end-to-end projects: turning, milling, drilling, electron beam welding, large scale of high-precision controls, heat treatment. 
Backed up by a long partnership with ArianeGroup, CSI now manufactures nozzle casings for the Ariane 6 and Vega C launcher and cryogenic tanks components.
Main activities:
Design, industrialization and production of systems and equipments meeting the highest standards in harsh environment.
Expertise in elaboration and production of composite & polyurethane products meeting the highest level of quality & performance requirements.
Large-size 3D controls and thermal treatment.
CSI manufactured all three-elements of Ariane 5’s nozzles thanks to its expertise in precision machining and welding.
CSI has a state-of-the-art industrial equipment: large scale electron beam welding and now offers a new process to manufacture quicker and to reduce costs: the flow-forming technology.
CSI has both static and mobile control means, suitable for large-size and high-precision metrology (including MMT-ZEISS).
CSI has a strong expertise in Composite & Polyurethane used in space industry.

entityDescription:
At Fraunhofer AISEC, the main focus of our applied research is the development of application-oriented security solutions and their custom integration in existing systems. The core competences of our approximately 100 highly qualified scientific and technical employees lie in the areas of hardware security and the security of embedded systems, product and intellectual property protection, network security, and security in cloud- and service-oriented computing.
Our clients operate in a variety of industrial sectors, such as the chip card industry, telecommunications, the automotive industry, and mechanical engineering, as well as the software and healthcare industries. Our goal is to support and improve the competitiveness of our clients and partners in the manufacturing and service sectors as well as those in the public sector.
Strategic partnerships with globally operating industrial companies as well as with international universities, in particular the University of Excellence TU Munich, guarantee the scientific excellence of our work and its market-driven implementation.
